Cell cycle Check-points
3 major check points:
1st point : in G1/S (Start point, Restriction point, Point of no return)
controls 2 events :
if the environment is favorable to mitosis
if the cell size is sufficient (N/C report)
When this point is reach, the cycle starts with no return
2nd point : between G2/M,
checks if all the DNA has been replicated and verify the quantity and
the quality of obtained DNA
3rd point : During Metaphasis,
checks if all chromosome are aligned on equatorial plane and are
well attached to the spindle
If any abnormality, the cell cycle stops and apoptosis starts
If cycle couldn’t stop => Cancer
